title: ZhongWenHubOfficialSourceSchema
description: Standard schema for official and authoritative HSK / Chinese language curriculum reference sources.

sourceId.description: Unique stable identifier for the source (e.g., HSK-OFFICIAL-001)

titleZh.description: Official Chinese title of the standard or publication

titleVi.description: Vietnamese descriptive title for ZhongWenHub pedagogy

publisher.description: Issuing or publishing authority (e.g., Ministry of Education, CLEC, CTI, BLCUP)

officialUrl.description: Direct canonical URL on official government or authorized publisher website

version.description: Standard code, edition or version string (e.g., GF 0025-2021, 2015 Syllabus)

hasAppendix.description: Whether the source contains formal appendices (vocab list, grammar outline, character list)

copyrightNotes.description: Detailed legal boundaries regarding verbatim copying vs editorial adaptation

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of inspection or retrieval

sha256.description: Cryptographic hash of document file if downloaded locally
